text: This report provides an update to the Board of Health on the Toronto Public Health (TPH) capital budget variance for the six months ended on June 30, 2019. As of June 30, 2019, TPH spent $2.056 million representing 42.3 percent of the 2019 Approved Capital Budget of $4.864 million.
The Board of Health Budget Committee recommends to the Board of Health that: 1. The report (August 19, 2019) from the Medical Officer of Health be received for information.
